summary: Decodes packed 16-bit RGBA4 texture pixels (4 bits per channel) to 32-bit float RGBA. Computes the source pixel pointer as this[6] (field 0x18) plus a3 * this[1045] (field 0x1054) plus a2 * this[1044] (field 0x1050). Loops over this[1046] (field 0x1058) pixels, consuming two bytes per pixel, and unpacks the 4-bit red, green, blue and alpha channels, each scaled by 0.06666667 (the 1/15 float held in flt_5AC108), writing four floats per pixel. If this[4] (field 0x10) is non-zero, calls ContactManifoldCleanup on the decoded float RGBA buffer.

operations.description: Compute the source pixel pointer as this[6] (field 0x18) plus a3 * this[1045] (field 0x1054) plus a2 * this[1044] (field 0x1050).
Iterate over this[1046] (field 0x1058) pixels (2 * this[1046] bytes), consuming two bytes per pixel and writing four floats per pixel.
Advance the input pointer by two bytes and the output pointer by four floats each iteration.
If this[4] (field 0x10) is non-zero, run the post-processing cleanup on the decoded buffer.
Call ContactManifoldCleanup(this, output_base) where output_base is computed as the base of the decoded float RGBA buffer (a4 - 4 * this[1046]).
